B_score_semantics.details: Independent NumPy arithmetic reproduces all 93,966 new and 93,966 original per-sequence curve cells exactly, in installed sequence-file order; all 20 primary metrics have zero observed error. All 10 comparison rows/deltas and 4 strict-target decisions match. No model-output-based normalization is present.
limits: LasHeR invalid GT means any x/y/w/h <= 0 after float32 load and rounding. The installed scorer assigns distance -1, counting these frames as PR/NPR successes; SR assigns overlap -1, counting them as failures. 1,260 frames satisfy this rule, including one first frame. The denominator retains all frames.
SR/MSR are unweighted means over 21 sampled threshold cells and sequences, not a trapezoidal integral or frame-weighted metric. NPR uses ground-truth width/height and representative threshold 0.20.

Exact score/curve equality does not imply exact trajectory equality. Complete input has 254/479 exact arrays and bytes, maximum absolute raw difference 2.6147972675971687e-12; only 478 rounded float32 arrays are equal.

1,967 local package files match the 3,556-entry remote manifest. The 1,589 extra paths are all GT-tree files and remain metadata-only.

The two local collection/aggregation exit-1 events are preserved in a retrospective ledger. Separate contemporaneous native terminal receipts were not supplied; the remote transport exit 0 does not attest to those local failures.

D_executed_paths.details: Actual evidence identifies evaluate_model.main -> prepare/worker_init/sequence -> MissingTracker -> MissingTrackerModel -> unchanged CADTrack backbone blocks/head; evaluator then registers bbox files in rgbt.LasHeR/RGBT234 and calls PR_LasHeR, NPR, SR_LasHeR, MPR and MSR. Numeric execution is independently corroborated by every output curve cell. Optional repair is disabled, patch_keep is absent, and no KD/training call occurs on this inference path. Generic PR/SR, GTOT/RGBT210 metrics, cross_layer candidate elimination, alternative pretraining loads and training dataset classes are not the generators of the claimed scores.
limits: Static application-source review and consistent native output records are not an instrumented runtime trace or authentication of external PyTorch/timm/OpenCV binaries.

The inherited evaluate_model docstring and run protocol say trained single model/single-view inference; for this checkpoint the explicit packaging/controller records establish zero-update evaluation of an already-trained E0.

E_scope.details: Supports a descriptive zero-update availability-aware inference-path control using one original E0 epoch20 checkpoint: two full conditions, 958 sequence-runs and 674,706 output frame rows. Complete five-metric equality and five adverse missing-input deltas are retained. Current RESULTS.md appropriately disclaims isolated module attribution and stronger conclusions.
limits: This is not a new training result, multi-seed robustness estimate or evidence of three effective paper modules.
The intervention changes both unobserved patch-embedding handling and historical-template availability; it is not a one-line causal intervention.
Metadata and launch files for E0-FT/E2 do not demonstrate their completion. BN or KD efficacy and E0-FT/E2 final metrics are outside this closed control.
Recorded seconds include multiprocessing/evaluation overhead and missing-frame holds; they are not a matched per-frame deployment latency benchmark.

F_evaluation_type.details: Real-GT OPE on provided LasHeR/RGBT234 annotation copies. Published-mask sensor absence is simulated, but the reference remains independently stored dataset annotations, not synthetic/model/self-supervised targets. The classification does not authenticate upstream annotation/image/checkpoint provenance.
